definitions.gloss: accidental death; death by accident; death in an accident
definitions.explanation: Dying as a result of an accident — a traffic accident, a workplace accident, a fall, or any similar unintended event. Contrasted with natural death, disease death, suicide, or homicide. Used in news reports, legal contexts, and insurance documents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{交通|こうつう}→交通：01584_koutsuu⟧{事故死|じこし}。
⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{若|わか}く→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{事故死|じこし}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My father died in an accident at a young age.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{事故死|じこし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{登山|とざん}→登山：03457_tozan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{届|とど}け{出|で}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: To prevent accidental deaths in the mountains, you are required to submit a climbing notification.

examples.japanese: ⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{病死|びょうし}→病死：22006_byoushi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{事故死|じこし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{保険金|ほけんきん}→保険金：15653_hokenkin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}いてあった→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The insurance contract stated that the payout differs between death by illness and accidental death.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧ (accident) and ⟦{死|し}→死：13248_shi⟧ (death). Refers to death caused by an accident, such as a traffic accident, fall, drowning, fire, or industrial accident. It is the standard term in news reports, police announcements, and insurance documents.

USAGE:
- As a noun: {事故死|じこし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧ (there are many accidental deaths)
- As a suru-verb: ⟦{若|わか}く→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{事故死|じこし}する (to die accidentally at a young age)
- Often preceded by a qualifier: ⟦{交通|こうつう}→交通：01584_koutsuu⟧{事故死|じこし} (traffic-accident death), ⟦{労働|ろうどう}→労働：03785_roudou⟧{事故死|じこし} (workplace-accident death)

REGISTER: Neutral, but matter-of-fact and somewhat blunt. In eulogies or sympathy letters, softer phrasing such as ⟦{亡|な}くなる→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧ (pass away) is preferred.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事故死|じこし}する: to die in an accident
- {事故死|じこし}{者|しゃ}: a person who died in an accident
- {事故死|じこし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧: to prevent accidental deaths
- ⟦{交通|こうつう}→交通：01584_koutsuu⟧{事故死|じこし}: death from a traffic accident

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{病死|びょうし}→病死：22006_byoushi⟧: death from illness — contrasted with accidental death on death certificates and insurance
- {変死|へんし}: unnatural death — a broader legal term covering accidents, suicide, and homicide
- ⟦{急死|きゅうし}→急死：18189_kyuushi⟧: sudden death — emphasizes suddenness, not necessarily accident
- ⟦{即死|そくし}→即死：11973_sokushi⟧: instant death — dying immediately at the scene of an accident
